description: Evaluation suite verifying Kahn topological wave compilation, parallel file-collision rejection, cycle detection, Context Fork hygiene, and single-turn near-misses.

evals.prompt: Compile this multi-skill grafo_execucao plan into Kahn topological waves with isolated_state_key Context Fork envelopes and <= 5 active rules per node.
evals.expected_output: Compiles Wave 0 (step_00) and Wave 1 (step_01a, step_01b in parallel over disjoint target_files), emits ContextTransitionEnvelope objects without raw history, and passes dag_chain_validator.py.
assertions: Groups independent nodes into parallel Kahn waves (total_waves == 2)
Assigns isolated_state_key and <= 5 active_rules per node

evals.prompt: Validate a DAG plan where worker_1 and worker_2 have no preconditions and both target shared/modular_orchestrator.py in Wave 0.
evals.expected_output: Halts wave dispatch deterministically and emits [FAIL: PARALLEL_FILE_COLLISION] identifying Wave 0 write contention on shared/modular_orchestrator.py.
assertions: Blocks parallel dispatch until serialized or split

evals.prompt: Compile a phases graph where phase A depends_on B and phase B depends_on A.
evals.expected_output: Detects circular dependency via Kahn in-degree sorting (has_cycle == true) and rejects dispatch with CYCLE_DETECTED.
assertions: Identifies has_cycle == true via Kahn algorithm

evals.prompt: Convert this single Markdown file report.md into a formatted PDF right now.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger chained-plan-orchestrator; single atomic task routes directly to html-pdf-converter.
assertions: Abstains from spinning up multi-wave DAG orchestration
Routes atomic PDF conversion directly to html-pdf-converter

evals.prompt: I have a brand-new epic idea to build a clinical portal—triage my intent across 4 quadrants, design Phase 0, and write a Complexity Tracking table from scratch.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger chained-plan-orchestrator; routes initial cognitive planning and intent triage to high-level-context-planner.
assertions: Abstains from wave execution before a plan exists
Routes initial Phase 0 cognitive planning to high-level-context-planner
